content: Mâsemaguehomoem Deus âgâsedomobyry imedyly wâgâ aguehobyry
Anju domodo takaze tynrenseim lelâlâ Deus imery awylygue, unâ iozeno kindatyby toenzepa kyjiwantaguene, kiuntuhoem, kieinwândyly kinmoba kitoem.
Deus, anju domodo Moisésram tâzezewenry nhuduhoem aguehobyry tâinwânseim myakâwândy mârâ. Einwântânrybyry modo tânagazenehonze myakâwândy Deus, aitomobyry aralâ.

Tutuze kurâ, saguhobyry tâzezewenry tâinwânseinhe awyly. Tâinwânsezeim kuru olâ Jesus xunârybyry. Mârâ saguhobyry tâzezewenry einwântânrybyry modo âzenagazeowânmy. Iwerâ Jesus einwântânry modo xurâem lakuru ise ton-honre kuru awyly xypyry etay. Kywymâry Jesus waunroem adâkezelâ tâdâsemaguely wâgâ. Idanipyry modo kyam âkealâ kuru awyly nutuen-homo lâpylâ.

Jesus eon-honrugue lelâ adyeseim anhetomoem, kurâ domodo adawihoem aieni modo anhetomoem, Deus eon-honrugue lelâ kuomazeâni anhetomoem warâ aiemâmy. Tyispiriturylâ Deus eyanmo ingonokyly, anhekylymo wâgâ enomedâzemo ize tato aralâ. Arâ myakâwâm Deus aguehomobyry âkeá lelâlâ awyly nhutuen-honly lâpylâ.
Jesus Cristo lelâ kâmakerim
Kau, onro warâ iweloem aiehoze kely mawânrâ âyanmo kâinwenily, mâuntuhomoem. Anju domodo keba Deus mârâ ume pymâem itoem agueho, tymery Jesuslâ.
Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ Davi, Deusram aguehobyry iwenibyem:

content.text: (‘xina’ uguely, idânârâ kurâ domodo xirâ onro anano modo.)
Âydâ xina itoem nuduwâpyra; inudâba aini kulâma xina.
Âyam tâenseim keba gâlâ tâise xina warâ.
Arâlâ olâ, xina agâlâ mâenanânehomba mawyly,
Âdiempa kulâ myakâwândy xina eon-honru mâunduypy, anju domodo eon-honru mâunduypy iatyay awyly.
Xirâ anaym mâungutyby modo xuturin-em xina itoem amygue olâ, tâdyren-honze, ton-honre warâ,
Kurâ domodo ise idânârâ tâlânro modo xuturim”

content: warâ iwenibyem awyly kurâ domodo wâgâ. “Kurâ domodo ise idânârâ tâlânro modo xuturim” keduo, idânârâ lelâlâ ise kurâ domodo nhutulyem awyly. Kiempyra olâ kurâ idânârâ tâlânro modo xuturin-em kurâ domodo awyly.

Jesuslâ idânârâ tâlânro modo xuturim. Jesus tarâ onro anaym tawyly ume, anju domodo iatyay kulâ myakâwâm mâkâ. Arâ aidyly myakâwâm, tyiguehoem, idânârâ einwânni modo âsemaguehoem. Deuslâ arâ aienehoim, kurâ domodo agâ koendâ tawyly tienehon-hoem, arâ tâensein-emba awylymo umelâ. Iwerâ olâ Jesus pymâ ton-honreim, tynrenseim warâ, igueypyem, kurâem itondobyry wâgâ.

Deuslâ idânârâ tâlânro modo aieni, eni warâ. Mâkâ peba-ro watay, âdy lâpeba tâise. Iozeno lelâ Deus anhekyly. Idânârâ tynynonro modo âsemaguely ize mâkâ, tymery agâ pymâ tynrenseinhe, tohoguezeinhe warâ itomoem. Arâ ize awyly, “ymeom” tâkeho modoem. Idânârâ Deus aguehobyry anhetuo, Jesus kâmakerin-em awyly, âsenagazedyly, iguely warâ, tunwynram katoem.

Inakanhe aguitobyry xygakewâm Jesus, Deus xurâem tywykeba kitoem. Awylygue mâkâ inakanhe aguitobyry xygakerimbyry, kurâ inakanhe kydawyly xygakeyby warâ, âjiunwym wâgâ lelâ kydawyly, Deus lelâ Kunwym awyly. Awylygue kakadâ Jesus pymâ tynrenseim awyly, tywypazeba olâ mâkâ “Ukonodo, koudo modo” keze tynynonro modoram.
Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ iwenibyem Jesus aguehobyry:

content.text: “Deus, âwâgâ agueze urâ ukonodoram, koudo modoram warâ.
Koendâ ise âynynonro modo duay âwâgâ auguely”

content: warâ iwenibyem awyly.
Iwenibyem lâpylâ Jesus aguehobyry: “Deus, imaxilâ kâtuly; âmâlâ iegâ, uwahugâ” kely. Isaíasdâ iwenibyem lâpylâ mâkâ aguehobyry: “Tarâ urâ, Deus, ymeombyry ara kâenkyly modo agâ” kely.

Kurâ, Jesus “ymeombyry ara kâenkyly modo” keho, tune, tunre warâ kurâ awylygue mawânkâ karalâ iazely. Arâ tyazeduo mawânkâ kâmakeze iguely, Diabu pymâem awyly, eon-honru warâ tyain-hoem. Diabu mawânkâ kyiguehoem aienehoim.

Tâwaneim tâbyguepa âsewanihoem sanâtyby, tywymâry “Aiekâ” kehobyry ize, izepa alelâ anhedyly, myara kâinane kurâ, Diabugue kywymâgu ume, ize, izepa alelâ “Aiekâ” kehobyry aguiendyly. Jesus kiuntuly iraynâ, kyiguely tytaze ani kurâ. Jesus olâ kâmakedâ awylygue, kyiguely kiyntabyra kydawyly iwerâ.
Anju domodo emakezeba myakâwâm Jesus âewyly, Abraão iweompyry kâmayno amaymba emakeze.

Kâmakezelâ âewyly awyly kiuntuduo, âdaituo Jesus karalâ kurâem idyly awyly tutuze kurâ. Arâ aidyly, Deus aguehobyry ara adâitoem, koendâ kitoem warâ. Jesus ewanu, kurâ domodo xurâem Deus agâ aguely, Deus aguehobyry kurâ domodoram egatuly warâ. Deus ety oday kurâ domodo eynynâ aguewâni modo iwymâry kuru aito ara aidyly. Âwâlâ Jesus âtuly kynynâ tyiguehoem; arâ awylygue mawânkâ Deus idânârâ ekanibyry modo inakanhe aito nhygakely.

Iwerâ Deus kieinwâmpyra kyenehonze kely Diabu-ro watay, Jesuslâ kon-hondâni, Diabu aguely kinwantaguebyra kitoem. Âdynanâowâm lâpylâ mawânkâ Jesus, Diaburam, âsenagazemâ warâ, Deus neinwâmpyra itoem aiese Diabu keday; Diabu aguehobyry aniempyra olâ myakâwâm.
